questions.q: (a) toward sustainable packaging solutions (b) several startups have shifted (c) their focus Choose the correct order of segments.
questions.solution: Start with the subject several startups, then have shifted their focus, then the direction toward packaging solutions. Order is bca.

questions.q: A. This flexibility, however, has also blurred the boundary between structured learning and passive consumption. B. Over the last few years, online courses have made higher education accessible to a much wider audience. C. Platforms now allow learners to complete modules entirely at their own pace. D. Many students, as a result, abandon courses before completing them. E. Educators argue that built-in accountability mechanisms could help address this gap. What is the correct sequence of sentences to form a meaningful paragraph?
questions.solution: B introduces access, C explains flexible pacing, A notes its drawback, D gives the outcome, and E proposes a remedy: BCADE.

questions.q: Which sentence should come FIRST in the paragraph?
questions.solution: Sentence 4 introduces coral reefs and their importance before the later discussion of threats.
questions.passage:
The following six sentences, when arranged in the correct order, form a coherent paragraph. Read them and
answer the questions that follow.
1. Consequently, many reef ecosystems have lost significant portions of their biodiversity within just a few years.
2. Rising ocean temperatures cause corals to expel the algae living within their tissues, a process known as
bleaching.
3. Marine biologists warn that repeated bleaching events leave reefs little time to recover between episodes.
4. Coral reefs support nearly a quarter of all marine species despite covering a tiny fraction of the ocean floor.
5. Without sustained recovery, entire reef systems risk collapsing within the coming decades.
6. When bleaching persists for too long, the corals eventually starve and die.

questions.q: Which sentence should come SECOND in the paragraph?
questions.solution: After the introduction, sentence 2 explains warming and bleaching. It must precede sentence 6’s reference to bleaching persisting.

questions.q: (a) the new metro line (b) is expected to reduce commute times (c) significantly Choose the correct order of segments.
questions.solution: The subject the new metro line comes first, followed by its expected effect and then the adverb significantly: abc.

questions.q: A. As a result, several state governments have begun offering additional subsidies for solar installations. B. Over the past decade, the cost of solar panels has fallen dramatically worldwide. C. However, inconsistent grid infrastructure in rural areas continues to limit adoption. D. This decline has made rooftop solar installations financially viable for middle-income households. E. Experts believe that resolving these infrastructural gaps is now the biggest hurdle to widespread adoption. What is the correct sequence of sentences to form a meaningful paragraph?
questions.solution: B introduces falling costs; D explains financial viability; A gives the resulting subsidies; C notes the infrastructure obstacle; E identifies resolving it as the remaining hurdle.

questions.q: (a) farmers have struggled to recover losses (b) caused by (c) the unseasonal rainfall Choose the correct order of segments.
questions.solution: The subject and verb are in a. Attach caused by in b to the object losses, then complete the cause with c: abc.

questions.q: Choose the most appropriate word for blank (1).
questions.solution: Transformed into means changed into a different form or role. It fits the movement from niche to mainstream.
questions.passage:
In the following passage, some words have been blanked out. For each blank, choose the most appropriate
option from the five given.

Telemedicine, once considered a niche convenience, has rapidly ___(1)___ into a mainstream component of
healthcare delivery. Patients in remote areas who once had to ___(2)___ long distances for a routine consultation
can now speak with a specialist within minutes. This shift has undeniably ___(3)___ access to care, yet it has also
raised concerns about the quality of diagnoses made without a physical examination. Physicians warn that
certain conditions simply cannot be ___(4)___ reliably over a video call, and that over-reliance on remote
consultations could cause serious symptoms to be missed. Health authorities are therefore under pressure to
___(5)___ clear guidelines that specify which conditions are appropriate for virtual care and which still require an
in-person visit.

questions.q: Choose the most appropriate word for blank (2).
questions.solution: Travel long distances is the natural collocation for reaching distant healthcare.

questions.solution: The ministry plans to release introduces the action; the revised guidelines is its object; the time phrase comes last. Order is bca.

questions.q: (a) the board approved the merger (b) despite strong opposition (c) from minority shareholders Choose the correct order of segments.
questions.solution: The action the board approved the merger precedes despite strong opposition from minority shareholders. Order is abc.
